changelog:
What's New in v1.1:
• Hourly forecast duration customization added (1 to 24 hours).
• Upcoming days forecast duration added (1 to 7 days).
• Fixed location search functionality.
• Replaced 'Tomorrow' with exact Day Names (e.g., Monday, Tuesday) with full translation support.
• Language translations improved and expanded for all new features.
• Removed extra and unnecessary permissions for better privacy.
